i searched for an answer to this one, but couldnt find it.
venenation - mask of 1000 - venenation - mask of a 1000 - venenation -
change of target is a legal combo as i understand it. but what about
Elder impersonation and is the blocking phase divided into "declaring a
block" , "attempting to block" and "succesfully blocking" or is it just
one phase.
If its just one phase i guess i could use the Elder impersonation (at
sup.)instead of the change of target??

venenation - mask 1000 -venenation - mask 1000 - venenation - Elder
impersonation.

Messages.Body:

news:23daeaad643907092a2...@mygate.mailgate.org...

>
> venenation - mask 1000 -venenation - mask 1000 - venenation - Elder
> impersonation.
>

By the time you play Venenation, the action has already been blocked
successfully, by card text on Venenation. I am unsure whether you could play
Elder Impersonation, but I'm believe that you cannot (I'm almost certain you
can't play it at superior... unsure about inferior). If you could play Elder
Impersonation, it wouldn't matter, because the block is already successful, and
combat will occur, unless you play Change of Target (or similar card).
